description: Connects a clinical laboratory test to the cell type in which its measurement is taken, as specified by the LOINC System axis.

source_contributions.scope: Laboratory tests with CLASSTYPE = 1 and status ACTIVE, TRIAL, or DISCOURAGED; DEPRECATED codes are excluded. Tests are represented only when they also have an identified Component-axis analyte relationship.
source_contributions.description: The System axis identifies the specimen cell type. Cell types are represented by Cell Ontology (CL) terms. Mappings use NodeNormalizer and BioPortal; unresolved parts may also be linked through curated LLM-derived mappings.
